name: RTX Lethal Ape MODS
summary: Step into the craziest version of Lethal Ape—RTX Lethal Ape MODS. Everything’s upgraded with insane graphics, realistic lighting, and environments that actually feel alive. But the best part? There’s tons of free mods to tweak your game however you want. It’s the Lethal Ape you love, but bigger, wilder, and way more fun.
